speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing dizziness, nausea, and imbalance; to help me identify the cause, how long have these symptoms been occurring?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone, Vitamin_B12_Level.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your blood work and metabolic panels are normal, we need to look elsewhere. Have you noticed any visual changes, such as double vision or blurred vision, or any difficulty with walking and coordination?

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain

speaker: Patient
text: 27-year-old male. The patient reports a sustained sensation of the room spinning since this morning, which is low grade and constant. He occasionally feels nauseous and has taken diphenhydramine to help him sleep, which also alleviates his symptoms slightly. He mentions recent increased intake of garlic due to trying to recover from a cold a few days ago. Past medical history is unremarkable.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) induced by viral labyrinthitis.
